review_text: "attention oily skinned people: this face wash is great. i have very oily skin so it is very important to use something that removes all the oil and leaves nothing behind while also not drying the hell out of my skin. a little goes a long way and the price is right. note: i do not have sensitive skin so i can't speak to that skin type."

"this is my absolute go to facial cleanser. leaves my skin feeling clean but never dried out. does not cause my skin to break out. a little goes a long way so it lasts quite a while. getting ready to purchase again as i’m getting low."
"i live this facial cleanser. it feels so soft with your skin , it does its job pretty well so you feel clean without harming your skin. i've been using it for a year and i love it."

"i use this everyday and i usually beeak out but with this i do not. it goes on great and rinses well. it really does the cleansing job well. i swear my face feels lighter it definately moisturizes my face."
"one of my goes too, i love that its a bigger container for daily use, good for sensitive skin, helps a lot with hydration. top quality for me!"
"this has become my go-to face wash. it requires only a tiny amount to create a lather, and it leaves me feeling thoroughly clean and rejuvenated."
"my favorite face wash. my skin is a mix of dry and oily and this seems to help. i would recommend getting the biggest bottle because it’s worth it with how long it lasts"
"this facial wash is so good. it leaves your skin fill clean and i have had no break outs. would repurchase again."
"best face wash i love this for acne prone skin and combo skin i have not broke out since"

"i use this everyday. i have extreme oily skin and you can feel the cleanliness right away. it gets the dirt and oil out of pores it doesn't dry skin out. this bottle seem to last long you surely do get money worth"

"once you start using this product you will feel the difference instantly, you can feel it washing way the dirt of your face and feel it feeling clean and moist at the face time, giving you face a bright appearance"

"this stuff is great. i’ve always been an expensive face wash girl but times are tough so i gave it a go and it’s perfect! doesn’t dry me out, it lathers up so nice, and it doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. my new staple."
"perfect everyday face wash and definitely changed my skin from dry to very oily but i think it’s worth it and it lasts from 8 months to a year coming from a person who uses it everyday"

"i’ve used cerave foaming facial cleanser for a while, and in many ways it’s a solid choice — especially if you deal with oily or combination skin. it foams up nicely, rinses off cleanly, and makes my skin feel fresh without leftover residue. the ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and niacinamide help keep my skin barrier balanced and not overly stripped."

"cerave is the cleanser i always use — this is already my second bottle and it lasts a long time. it’s very gentle, has no scent, and works really well for my dry skin. the texture is a bit gel-like, so it doesn’t irritate or leave my skin feeling tight. i really like it and it keeps my skin feeling clean and comfortable"
"i love that this is a clean product for such a cheap price. it removes my make up easily also is good for getting off sunscreen.’"
"switched from the hydrating cleanser to the foaming for my oily skin."

"i have sensitive, allergy prone skin that likes to break out of the slightest provocation. a lot of the stuff i've used in the past has stripped my skin and left it feeling dry, but this actually leaves my skin feelin soft without any irritation. i even got my husband to start using it and he loves it, too."
"gentle, soft and give a soft smooth touch to your skin, people qho have oily skin this is very good product moisturize your skin without overly oily touch."
"best foaming cleanser. if you have oily, sensitive, acne-prone skin, this is for you. it gets rid of all that buildup without stripping my face. very gentle and foams well. also, great value."

"this stuff made me realize i don’t have an oily face - it was incredibly drying and made me look way older. as someone with 37 year old skin i just need something that is more gentle and has more hydration! i consider myself to have combination skin with an oily t zone."

"i bought it after reading all the recommendations, however it's not as great as said. i have oily combination skin, it does dry the skin after using, and doesn't keep it matt long. i don't like it's texture so much compared to other products. so basically it's ok, but there are better."
"love this cleanser, but more than once the pump arrives not working correctly"
"i made a mistake and bought this without noticing that it was for oily skin."
"i love the foaming face wash, i purchased two! unfortunately, the pump on each of them is broken! so annoying ! it’s going to be a no for me on value, since it will be a pain to dispense!"
"great for moisture, but never really felt like a clean finish"
"unfortunately, this cleanser irritated my teenage daughter’s sensitive skin"
"unfortunately this made my skin peel especially around my nose and chin. maybe my skin isn’t oily enough for this. i’m not sure. i loved the foam though. made my skin feel clean, but tight and dry."
"my daughter uses this daily.  she says it works good."
"i was excited to try this but i can’t get the pump to work. i have to open the whole top and pour some out. then, i mix it with water to try to make the foam myself boo"
"it may be a great product otherwise but i'll never know because it contains 2 parabens."

"it cleans well and leaves the skin feeling fresh, but i didn’t notice a big difference as i expected. the texture is nice and it doesn’t dry out the skin too much, though it doesn’t really control oil as much as it claims. good cleanser, but not a game changer"
"my bottle came only half way filled up."
"my husband says it’s so so - not his favorite but he doesn’t hate it"

"because it’s so sunny in colorado, my skin has gotten a lot darker, so i’ve been applying sunscreen every day. since using sunscreen means i need to wash my face more often, i bought this cleanser. for now, i use it once at night, and it seems fine. the only issue is that if i don’t moisturize right after washing, my face gets really dry."

"it wasn't what i expectedthis cleanser promises to take care of the skin, but in my case it left it little moisturised and, worst of all, it caused me an acne outbreak after a few days of use. i don't recommend it if you have sensitive or acne-prone skin. i expected something softer and more effective."
"very gental but not thorough"
"probably for the readings and might deserve a higher rating. it’s just that it says foaming and there’s no foam it. the only reason i give it three stars i’m not saying it’s bad product."
"very excellent product bad packaging"

"i like this face soap because it is soft and does not irritate my skin. however, i don't think i'm getting a big difference in my skin in terms of cleaning or reducing pores. you may need to use it for longer to see more meaningful results. overall, it's a decent soap, but it's not the best if it's the best for my specific needs."

"good cleaner but has not helped me. i’ve been using it for a little more than 6 months and haven’t seen a difference in my skin. maybe i just got the wrong one. this bottle does last quite a while though. i’ve had it for 6 months and it’s about halfway gone. i use it twice a day"
"disappointed that it really doesn't foam at all.  will not be buying again."
"a little goes a long way. please don’t use a lot. it will take a little while to wash off."

"the cerave foaming facial cleanser is great for removing dirt and oil without feeling harsh. it lathers well and leaves the skin feeling clean, but it can be a bit drying, especially for those with sensitive or dry skin. overall, a solid choice for normal to oily skin types."
"lacome is much more better produc for people have oil face skin."
"nice product, but terrible dispenser pump. very hard to pump, as the the soap is too thick. please fix this!!!"

"i don't feel like my skin gets clean with this. i usually take off my makeup with a makeup remover then wash it but i feel like my skin is still dirty, i started breaking out after using this consecutively for two weeks. didn't see any changes after two months."

"i’ve used it several times across 4 months, it makes the skin soft and smooth after using it, but the labels advise that you only apply it around your cheeks, so… it’s kind of inconvenient in that way.the scent is not disturbing, but it’s not great either."
"a really good skin care product, but not the best option for those with oily skin. after about a week, it dried out my face to the point of red blotches."
"the cleanser has leaked in the box. i haven’t tried the product yet."

"this product contains sodium lauryl sulfate (sls), a foaming agent. if you are prone to canker sores, studies have shown that products with sls in it should be avoided. either that, or be careful to keep it away from your lips. another thing to keep in mind: sls is also used in some toothpastes, like tom's of maine, as a foaming agent."
"can’t say much but i used it in combination with oil control moisturizing face cream but breaks me up so bad"
"it doesn’t work for oily face"
"used to love but after reading ingredients will find a new skincare wash"

"does not foam at all. it's essentially their lotion rebottled to make people think it's soap. my skin has never felt less clean than after using this product. i have a beard and even trying to lather it on my face with my beard there are zero bubbles--again, this is lotion bottled as facewash and is horrible quality. good luck trying to reach them for a comment also."
"terrible, made my skin more oily. i left in a trip and didn’t have time to return it, but would like a refund. caused even worse breakouta"
"didn't realize it was oil free and hate this formula.  makes my face feel so dry!"
"product is not foaming. it is a thick gel with no lather. would not recommend if you like foaming cleaner. leaves a slimy feel on face."

"completely ruined my skin. broke out everywhere. my skin was in great shape before, but just had a little extra oil than what i like so tried this product. did not work at all and ruined my skin barrier!!!????"

"absolutely destroyed my skin. when i was as younger, i had acne so bad i had to go on accutane. i bought this to try and dabble in some self care. this absolutely tanked my skin. my entire face is bumpy, dry, and only getting worse. i'm trying to moisturize it and figure out how i can balance and fix this but it's only getting worse. avoid at all costs!!"

"i have the impression that this product is fake! it caused me an allergy and my face broke out in itchy pimples, which i find strange because i’ve bought this same product at ulta beauty before and it didn’t cause the same reaction. horrible."
"sadly i didn’t research enough and found this product has parabens."

"the bottle dispenser pump doesn’t work it’s broken , couldn’t return cuz i had bought it ahead of time so as not to run out , so make sure you check that it works properly or you’ll be having to open the bottle every single time which is very inconvenient"

"a dermatologist recommended this for my oldest a few years ago.. my second child is 13 and had some breakouts so i bought it for her. she has an allergic reaction immediately after - skin got bright red and hot and dry.it worked well for my son, but i would do a test before applying all over your face, especially if you have sensitive skin."
"broke my face out really bad"

"i’m so disappointed!! i look periodically to see if cerave soap still contains parabens. the “material type” here states that this is paraben free, but the bottle i got contains both methyl and propyl parabens. (see photo) must return. please update your site to show this product still contains parabens so others, like me (who are sensitive to parabens) won’t waste time ordering this product."

"bottle arrived in a condition less than new. it looks like it was slid across concrete before being packaged or perhaps returned and packaged for me. i ordered three other products & those boxes were popped open as well. doesn’t look new and i will not be washing my face with this because who knows if it’s been tampered with."
"broke me out like crazy"
"after a few days of using this face wash it has dried my face out soooo bad. i have never had this issue in my life with any other face wash so i will be returning asap"

"i switched from panoxyl to this cerave product as it has a huge review and felt like a lighter product to use on screen. but after using for around 2-3 weeks, i regret my decision of switching from panoxyl. i have started getting sudden breakouts, dryness around my chin and forehead. i woudnt recommend this to people with sensitive skin."

"i don’t know how they get away with this, but they call their product “paraben free” while including parabens anyway?! so unethical! i will thoroughly read the ingredients of all cerave products going forward. they should not be allowed to get away with this."

"i decided to change skin care after years of using proactive and gave this a chance cause of all the great reviews. well it was a mistake and i have it 3 weeks to try and give this a chance past purging and my skin broke out more and more and more. waste of money, lots of stress incured as well. look the other way."
"the package was delivered with half of the cleanser leaking. i needed this urgently, otherwise i would have returned it."
"not foamy at all. if anything is all slimy"
"doesn’t foam up as describedface doesn’t feel clean afterwards eitherclear looking liquid that is “flat” and doesn’t lather up or do anything like getting makeup off, etc"
